review: Verified in real headless iPhone Chrome: 22/22 POI categories, sea's three internal SVG morphs, real scale animation, yellow-star morph, media, route pages and top search. Build .15: reversible map-backed empty/filled bookmark with exact map yellow, zero loss of Brief/media/links, optional plan/visited status, per-section editing only, title/close and adjacent bookmark/navigation header, consistent subsection visuals. Guide import extracts URLs from WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili and other pasted share text and retains source/title/original text; link opening remains subject to original platform restrictions. Root unchanged; real iPhone Safari tactile acceptance still pending.
